message: argument {index} of `{name}` may not be omitted
description: An argument is left empty (`f(a, , c)`). The LRM allows that only in a few places: the tolerance arguments of `cross`, `above` and `timer`, the direction of `cross` and the period of `timer`, the coefficient lists and tolerance of a Laplace filter, and the coefficient lists and transition time of a Z-domain filter. Everywhere else each argument must be written; this one is required.
actions: Write the argument, or remove the extra comma if it was not meant to be there.
